tools.name: url-metadata
tools.description: Fetch a public https URL and extract HTML head metadata ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects. Returns JSON { url, final_url, content_type, title?, description?, canonical?, lang?, open_graph, tw
